name: Graaz, Unstoppable Juggernaut
oracle_text:
Juggernauts you control attack each combat if able.
Juggernauts you control can't be blocked by Walls.
Other creatures you control have base power and toughness 5/3 and are Juggernauts in addition to their other creature types.
blocked_sentences: Juggernauts you control attack each combat if able.
Juggernauts you control can't be blocked by Walls.

needs.what: a static ability's `affects` filter whose `subtypes` clause matches subtypes granted by layer-4 `add_subtype` statics (here Graaz's own third line, which makes every other creature you control a Juggernaut), so that `attacks_if_able` and `block_restriction` with `affects: {controller: you, subtypes: [Juggernaut]}` reach the creatures the card itself turned into Juggernauts
needs.why_existing_wont_do: characteristics._matches / _matches_printed read printed subtypes plus obj.added_subtypes (the one-shot add_subtype op) only, never the add_subtype static, so `subtypes: ["Juggernaut"]` on lines 1 and 2 would apply to Graaz alone and skip every creature line 3 makes a Juggernaut -- the whole point of the card. Rewriting the filter as `types: [Creature], controller: you` is a substitution that diverges under text-changing effects on Graaz and type-removing effects with later timestamps, so it is not filed as an answer. Line 3 itself is expressible (set_pt + add_subtype statics with `exclude_self`), and the Wall half of line 2 is `blockers: {subtypes: [Wall]}`
